title: Murfreesboro, TN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Murfreesboro, TN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Murfreesboro is a city in TN with a population of 150,000. Fast-growing Nashville suburb with Middle Tennessee State University and Stones River. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.4.
